pull_request.title: Documentation: illustrate the tested staggered Si-W ECAL
pull_request.head: codex/staggered-siw-layout-drawing
pull_request.body:
Adds SVG/PNG drawings of the tested PR136/137 Si–W prototype: four barrel module phases, a sampling cut, full/narrow module dimensions and the four actual endcap packings. The illustration retains the short-slab24mm adaptation and remaining sector seams. DES-030/DES-031 approval states and maintained geometry are unchanged.

![Staggered Si-W layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/15af2785bc795e44b87e64b2c772cb7cb5c737a2/docs/design/figures/DES-031/staggered/staggered-siw-layout.png)

[Vector SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/staggered-siw-layout-drawing/docs/design/figures/DES-031/staggered/staggered-siw-layout.svg). Source/provenance and reproduction recipe are in docs/validation/staggered-siw-drawing/README.md. Regeneration explicitly requires a clean source checkout at3ebafd340b0e084c5e42e57123de115e3f489244; it never substitutes current-main packing for the historical tested geometry.

Validation passed: exact source commit/seven clean blobs/recipe binding, original dimensions and112/107/110/101module counts, byte-identical SVG/PNG replay, visual inspection, project/inventory/session/interaction/token validation and resource-site build. Renderer was pre-existing librsvg2.62.3; no installation or native simulation. All new files are below400kB and contain no event payloads. Active-turn exact usage remains unknown.
